Home.jsx ProfilEntry: confirmed 0 emojis in [data-testid=profil-entry] section, all 3 cards (profil-idee/perdu/depend) render div.w-12.h-12.rounded-full.bg-brick/10 containing lucide-react SVG (Target/HelpCircle/Shuffle). Found ONE bug: clicking profil-idee redirects to /trouve-ta-voie&profil=idee (missing '?' separator) when prenom is empty.

ui_bugs.issue: Malformed URL when prenom is empty: navigates to '/trouve-ta-voie&profil=idee' instead of '/trouve-ta-voie?profil=idee'. Root cause: line 300 template literal `${p.to}${prenom ? `?prenom=...` : ""}&profil=${p.key}` uses '&' unconditionally. Fix: use '?' when prenom empty, '&' when prenom present, e.g. `${p.to}?${prenom ? `prenom=${encodeURIComponent(prenom)}&` : ''}profil=${p.key}`.

action_items: Fix Home.jsx line 300 Link `to` template to always use '?' as first param separator and '&' between params. Applies to all 3 profil cards (idee/perdu/depend).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx line 300: query-string construction is buggy when prenom is empty — produces '/trouve-ta-voie&profil=idee' (invalid). Should be `?profil=...` or `?prenom=...&profil=...`.
